title: just-deliver environment descriptor
description: What an environment (its substrate) publishes so the resolver can resolve ${env.<path>} references. name, region and tier are addressable as env.name, env.region and env.tier; every other env.<dot.path> resolves inside values. grantable lists the values paths workloads may grant on (security boundary).

name.description: Environment name; same pattern as workload ids.

grantable.description: Dot paths under values that workloads may grant on. Each must exist in values.

values.description: Substrate outputs: nested mappings of strings. Keys must not contain dots, so a dot path is unambiguous (enforced by the loader; the schema validator ignores propertyNames).
